name: Hotel Gasthof Purner
beschreibung: The Hotel Gasthof Purner is located in the municipality of Thaur, directly at the foot of the Nordkette in the Tyrolean Inntal. The immediate surroundings are characterized by forest and mountain landscapes of the Karwendel and Tuxer Voralpen region. From Thaur, marked routes lead into the surrounding mountains and through the Thaurer Klamm. In winter, the ski areas Glungezer, Axamer Lizum and the Nordkettenbahnen offer opportunities for downhill skiing. The hotel's amenities include a wellness area with sauna as well as a Tiroler Gaststube. The Tiroler Gaststube focuses on regional cuisine. Guests can expect a traditional family-run establishment with down-to-earth Tyrolean atmosphere and a range of outdoor activities.
